title: Nellie Lutcher's family band and drummer Elric Joseph
summary: Reason names Lutcher's brothers and father in Lake Charles and tells of Elric Joseph, whom he later sent for in Indianapolis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. I see. And did Nelly Lodger's father play in the band? Not in our band.
No. No, he had his own band down there with Joe and Bubba Lodger. That's her brothers.
Daddy played bass. Mm-hmm. And who was Joe the drummer? Joe Elric Joseph. Elric Joseph was his right name. That's right.

He was from, he was born in Louisiana, but most of his folks lived down in Galveston, Texas. Because when I sent for the band, for my little group down here to come to Indianapolis, Indiana, it was Elric Joseph that I had sent for. Mm-hmm. See, because I figured I couldn't get Freddie. Freddie was already in Detroit. I didn't know about Freddie. Freddie was living in Chicago, playing up there with Ruben Hughes and a bunch. Now, when I had this little band at the Nighthawks, when I left King Oliver's band, I had on drums, I took him out of a band out of Alexander, Louisiana, who was Joseph Elric.
